CosmicHorror.description: Whenever <style="Faction_Genestealers">the Patermine</style> defeats an enemy, it places a <style="Decoy">decoy</style> on the hex of that enemy. Other enemies surrounding the defeated unit have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to be <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round, and have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to trigger <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> a second time, if they have it. When <style="Faction_Genestealers">the Patermine</style> moves onto a decoy, it <style="Healing">heals</style> itself for <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>.
